title: Selected Topics in Aerospace Engineering; Near-Space Navigation
description:
Prerequisites: ENAE404, 441, or equivalent Recommended Prerequisite: ENAE601

This course will provide students with a practical foundation in applied space navigation. The focus is on computational techniques and the astrodynamics, statistics, and estimation that underlies them. Near-space trajectories are those within 1.5 million km of the earth, a region that includes the sun-earth colinear Lagrange points (L1 and L2).

Those sections that begin with a letter are designated for Master of Engineering students and are not intended for Master of Science or Ph.D.Students.
